# Cloud Cost Planner

> Free browser calculator: given a server size, monthly outbound traffic, the share of static files, stored data and where
> visitors are, it prices every VPS and cloud plan (Hetzner, DigitalOcean, Vultr, Linode, Lightsail, Contabo, Oracle Cloud,
> AWS EC2, Google Cloud, Azure) combined with object storage (R2, S3, B2, Wasabi, Spaces, Hetzner) and CDNs (Cloudflare,
> CloudFront, Bunny) for one month, and recommends the cheapest setup. Prices checked by hand against each provider's
> pricing page (2026-11-01); excluding VAT.

- Planner: https://cost.1ms.dog/ (also /zh-cn/, /zh-tw/, /ja/, /ko/, /es/, /fr/, /de/, /pt/, /ru/)
- Pages: https://cost.1ms.dog/blog-hosting-cost/, https://cost.1ms.dog/saas-hosting-cost/, https://cost.1ms.dog/proxy-vps-cost/, https://cost.1ms.dog/download-site-cost/, https://cost.1ms.dog/video-hosting-cost/, https://cost.1ms.dog/backup-storage-cost/, https://cost.1ms.dog/aws-egress-cost/, https://cost.1ms.dog/gcp-egress-cost/, https://cost.1ms.dog/azure-egress-cost/, https://cost.1ms.dog/oracle-egress-cost/, https://cost.1ms.dog/1tb-egress-cost/, https://cost.1ms.dog/10tb-egress-cost/, https://cost.1ms.dog/100tb-egress-cost/, https://cost.1ms.dog/aws-vs-hetzner-bandwidth/, https://cost.1ms.dog/hetzner-vs-digitalocean/, https://cost.1ms.dog/hetzner-vs-vultr/, https://cost.1ms.dog/digitalocean-vs-vultr/, https://cost.1ms.dog/vultr-vs-linode/, https://cost.1ms.dog/lightsail-vs-ec2/, https://cost.1ms.dog/r2-vs-s3/, https://cost.1ms.dog/b2-vs-wasabi/, https://cost.1ms.dog/cloudfront-vs-cloudflare/, https://cost.1ms.dog/cheapest-vps-4gb/, https://cost.1ms.dog/cheapest-object-storage/, https://cost.1ms.dog/cheapest-cdn/
- Price data (JSON, CORS): https://cost.1ms.dog/data/vps.json, https://cost.1ms.dog/data/egress.json, https://cost.1ms.dog/data/storage.json, https://cost.1ms.dog/data/cdn.json, https://cost.1ms.dog/data/rates.json
